newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatar shares continue advance in upbeat trade.
newsitem.headline: Qatar shares continue advance in upbeat trade.

text.p: Shares at Qatar's unofficial stock market advanced further in upbeat trade in the week to Thursday, brokers said.
The Commercial Bank of Qatar's 18-share index broke the 122-mark for the first time since its launch in June 1995 to close at 122.11 points from 121.99 in the previous week.
Six shares firmed, one ticked down and 11 were steady.
Qatar General Insurance was the top gainer, rising 10 riyals to 545. Qatar Insurance shed two riyals to 676.
Al Khaleej Insurance gained two riyals to 297 and Qatar Navigation five riyals to 720.
Qatar Cinema, Qatar Cement and Qatar Flour Mills advanced two riyals each to 182, 309 and 307 riyals respectively.
